summary: tools/set-version.mjs sets the app version in package.json, tauri.conf.json, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock from one argument, and --check exits 1 naming the file that disagrees

coordination.notes: No existing owner of the version: nothing in the tree derives any of the three declarations from the others, so this is a new single owner rather than a sibling of one. Registered as test:version in both package.json and tools/test-suites.json so the check runs in the suite; tools/test-suites.json joins the touches list for that reason (a suite registered in one place never runs).

findings.what: src-tauri/Cargo.lock carries the app's version too
findings.judgement: Included as a fourth file. Leaving it out is worse than not touching it: the next cargo build rewrites the entry to match Cargo.toml, so a bump commit is followed by a stray lockfile diff in whichever worktree builds first. Its reader is anchored to the dr-companion [[package]] block rather than the first `version = ` in the file, which would report a dependency's version and be right about nothing.

checks: node tools/set-version.mjs --check: exit 0, 'OK   all 4 files declare 0.1.1', one line per file
round trip: set 9.9.9, --check exit 0 at 9.9.9, set 0.1.1 -> all four files byte-identical to before (md5 unchanged on all four)

sabotage, run four times, once per file: replaced 0.1.1 with 0.9.9 by hand -> exit 1 each time, naming the file. 'FAIL the version disagrees. src-tauri/tauri.conf.json says 0.9.9, where the others say 0.1.1.' and the same for Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and package.json; each restored and the md5 set matched the pre-sabotage set
the sabotage script aborts with exit 9 if its own edit changes nothing, so a sabotage that failed to land cannot read as a check that failed to fire
denominator: a reader that stops matching returns null, and four nulls agree perfectly, so --check fails on an unreadable file before it compares anything
replaceOnce refuses on zero or multiple matches: a string edit that finds no anchor and writes the file unchanged is exactly the silent no-op this script exists to prevent
the writer reads all four files back after writing rather than trusting four string edits
